prompt_en: Create a photorealistic adventure-fashion photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties using the attached portrait as an appearance reference, preserving her recognizable facial proportions, dark brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair. She is at a flooded tropical mangrove launch, retrieving a floating surfboard after a small broken wave. Her focal swim outfit is a fitted long-sleeve rash guard with a high crew neckline, visible diagonal raglan shoulder seams, and contrasting pale side panels, worn as a separate top over high-waisted swim briefs with curved high-cut leg openings. The rash guard hem overlaps the briefs waistband, while both curved leg openings remain clearly visible. Deep teal stretch swim fabric carries small water beads and gentle tension folds where her arm reaches; the pale side panel stays readable against the darker torso. Her surfboard lies flat on the water beside her, its rounded nose and rail visible, and the wrist nearest it makes clear hand contact with the board rail. A small wave divides around her legs, leaving a curved white foam trail across the dark shallow water. Photograph the interaction in cool overcast with a narrow sunbreak, with bright individual spray droplets suspended beside a softly shaded face. Her body turns three quarters toward camera while her face looks toward the board. Use a vertical full-body composition, enough space around the feet to read the water contact, a natural eye-level viewpoint, and a moderate telephoto perspective. Prioritize legible garment construction, recognizable reference appearance, believable board contact, and the crossing of luminous water droplets over the darker setting. Place the woman left of center so the board rail leads diagonally toward her contacting hand. Let the sunbreak graze the spray from camera right while the mangrove canopy softens the light across her face.
